bachelor_field.value: EE, computer engineering, CS or related; other degree + relevant industrial experience may be considered
bachelor_field.quote: If you have another type of degree or diploma combined with relevant industrial experience, you may be considered.

non_cs_notes.quote: If you have another type of degree or diploma combined with relevant industrial experience, you may be considered.

prerequisites.value: Strong foundation in CS (programming, algorithms, data structures) and mathematics (linear algebra, probability, statistics)

min_gpa.value: First-class standing normally (numeric not stated); 2:1 may be below this

toefl.value: iBT 90, no section below 20 (before Jan 2026); new scale 4.5/4.0 after Jan 21 2026

english_waiver.value: yes - degree from recognized institution with English as language of instruction
english_waiver.quote: you have a degree from a recognized institution at which the language of instruction is English

english_req.value: IELTS 6.5/6.0, TOEFL; exemption for English-medium degree

other_requirements.value: Two assessment reports from academic or professional references, resume, statement of intent (2 pages max), transcripts

application_fee.value: 187.00 CAD if any documents from outside Canada (145.25 within) - from search snippet, verify on uvic.ca

deadline.value: Sept entry intl April 30; Jan entry intl Aug 31

tuition.value: ~42,000 CAD international (2025-26 estimate), 1 year, plus $2,000 deposit

coop_internship.value: Optional co-op up to three terms after academic portion (max 12 months)

eligibility_notes: Provisional: explicit experience pathway for non-CS degrees; Philip's 5-7 years DevOps fits. Risks: 'normally first-class' standing vs 2:1, and CS/maths prerequisites. English waiver likely. Curriculum is data-science oriented with algorithms/optimization (maths-heavy), weak match to cloud/IT-management. Tuition ~42k CAD within budget.
